description: Source code for symbol management in a configuration system, including symbol definitions, property handling, dependency checking, and value calculation.

methods.name: sym_add_default
methods.description: Adds a default property to a symbol with a specified default value.

methods.name: sym_init
methods.description: Initializes system symbols, including setting the UNAME_RELEASE string.

methods.name: sym_get_type
methods.description: Returns the effective type of a symbol, considering visibility and choice value status.

methods.name: sym_type_name
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a symbol type.

methods.name: sym_get_choice_prop
methods.description: Retrieves the choice property of a symbol if it exists.

methods.name: sym_get_env_prop
methods.description: Retrieves the environment property of a symbol if it exists.

methods.name: sym_get_default_prop
methods.description: Retrieves the default property of a symbol if it is visible.

methods.name: sym_get_range_prop
methods.description: Retrieves the range property of a symbol if it is visible.

methods.name: sym_get_range_val
methods.description: Calculates the numeric value of a symbol based on its string value and base.

methods.name: sym_validate_range
methods.description: Ensures a symbol's value is within its defined range, adjusting if necessary.

methods.name: sym_set_changed
methods.description: Marks a symbol as changed, updating associated menu flags.

methods.name: sym_set_all_changed
methods.description: Marks all symbols as changed.

methods.name: sym_calc_visibility
methods.description: Calculates the visibility of a symbol based on its properties and dependencies.

methods.name: sym_choice_default
methods.description: Finds the default choice symbol for a given choice.

methods.name: sym_calc_choice
methods.description: Calculates the default choice symbol for a choice symbol.

methods.name: sym_calc_value
methods.description: Calculates the current value of a symbol based on its dependencies and defaults.

methods.name: sym_clear_all_valid
methods.description: Clears the validity flags for all symbols and recalculates modules symbol.

methods.name: sym_tristate_within_range
methods.description: Checks if a tristate value is within the symbol's allowed range.

methods.name: sym_set_tristate_value
methods.description: Sets a symbol's tristate value, respecting range constraints.

methods.name: sym_toggle_tristate_value
methods.description: Cycles a tristate value through its possible states.

methods.name: sym_string_valid
methods.description: Validates if a string value is valid for a symbol.

methods.name: sym_string_within_range
methods.description: Checks if a string value is within the symbol's range.

methods.name: sym_set_string_value
methods.description: Sets a string value for a symbol, validating and updating flags.

methods.name: sym_get_string_default
methods.description: Retrieves the default string value for a symbol, considering defaults and dependencies.

methods.name: sym_get_string_value
methods.description: Returns the current string value of a symbol.

methods.name: sym_is_changable
methods.description: Determines if a symbol's value can be changed based on visibility.

methods.name: sym_lookup
methods.description: Looks up or creates a symbol by name, with optional flags.

methods.name: sym_find
methods.description: Finds a symbol by name, excluding constant symbols.

methods.name: sym_expand_string_value
methods.description: Expands embedded symbols within a string, replacing $-prefixed names with their values.

methods.name: sym_escape_string_value
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for safe use.

methods.name: sym_re_search
methods.description: Searches symbols matching a regex pattern, returning an array of matching symbols.

methods.name: sym_check_deps
methods.description: Checks for recursive or invalid dependencies among symbols.
